{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().round(2)

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f'Mean flipper length by species:\n{mean_flipper_by_species}')
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species} ({highest_mean_value} mm)')"}
